scope_notes: All native GPU cases serialized; no compiler overlapped timed supply/comparison runs. Generated linked sources shared across many objects; cold Tack per-session derived caches, warm OS cache.
Xvfb/NVIDIA native windows, not a physical monitor or Windows desktop. Low-resolution picker tests use actual 800x600 and 1024x768 desktops.

Context attempts context/context-final failed through incorrect test targeting/container-byte comparison; context-verified had mislabeled 2x; context-scales missed Keymap due to an extra Down; only context-final-checked accepted, with visible Keymap assertion.
First production attempts found test-owned orphan pickers, then missing PATH xclip; only production-800-screen accepted. Pickers now scoped to child process ownership.
First old-runtime idle attempt was a non-executable frozen copy; only menu-idle-final-* accepted.
Whole-process RSS and driver thread activity are retained; neither cache payload caps nor this GPU emulate a 128 MB/Pentium III machine.
